notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pressing "Quit" in the game over screen messed up your save. If you still have your file and didnt delete and restart it should work now.
[*]Boss fights breaking or not starting on respawn
[/list]

notes.title: Want more game? Well, you can have that RIGHT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Easter Everyone 🐇.•*¨`*•.¸[/h1]
Us here at SunDeer Studios come to you with a big update to our demo as we work to finish up the game.
With this update you’ll get some bug fixes.
And we are also including level 2, The Dungeons, in the demo to play as you wait. 
And who knows maybe there is a clue in there about when the release date is 🤫
Enjoy the new level and these easter eggs of our main characters! 😁
PS. We will try to preserve your saves from the demo to the full release.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/cb51587afcc47e353a1da449df60c38f3fc18be7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/3e0dc2e93d27d53caaac57788960b5fcbf29c157.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/2c3305d4b68ec85bd4e8521a6e37cbe9a00373b6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/396939943c2c1ca540279d4cb899ce9958bd95ac.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/7abe588b62bfedd9e4b2d046701273818e45d9bc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/3d4a383ab923dd9bd6efc0efee86255183364e75.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/593c6b7f001be7d39d00869fcdaa8c6df057a997.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508201/751adda5ab0f485bb0ee6ad988e8232636551f7c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Now what can you expect from the full release[/h2]
[list]
    [*]More levels and wickedness🤪
    [*]Multiple boss fights🤯
    [*]Achivements🥳
    [*]Steam leaderboard for level speedrun times🤠
[/list]

So please wishlist the full game. It's not long untill the full release 😉
